title: Composites Among $[\xi 7^n]$ and Right-Truncatable Primes in Base 7
canonical_statement: For every real $\xi>0$ the sequence of integer parts $[\xi 7^{n}]$, $n=0,1,2,\dots$, contains infinitely many composite numbers. Second, there is no infinite right truncatable prime in base 7.
